recipe_version.title: Käsespätzle with Caramelized Onions and Cucumber-Dill Salad
recipe_version.description: Southern German cheese spätzle: soft homemade egg dumplings layered with nutty Gruyère and Emmental, baked until bubbling, and crowned with deep-brown butter-caramelized onions and chives. Served with a cool, tangy cucumber-dill salad.

ingredients.name: microbial-rennet Gruyère-style cheese
ingredients.display_name: Gruyère-style Alpine cheese made with microbial (vegetarian) rennet

ingredients.name: microbial-rennet Emmental cheese
ingredients.display_name: Emmental or Swiss cheese made with microbial (vegetarian) rennet

ingredients.name: kosher salt
ingredients.note: 1 tsp batter, 2 tsp pot water, 1/4 tsp onions, 1/4 tsp salad

steps.title: Preheat and mix the batter
steps.body: Turn the oven on to 400 F to preheat. Whisk the flour, 1 tsp salt, and the nutmeg in a large bowl. Whisk the eggs and milk, pour into the flour, and beat with a wooden spoon 2 minutes until smooth, thick, and bubbling. Let the batter rest. Slice the onions, grate the cheeses, and slice the cucumber.

steps.title: Caramelize the onions
steps.body: Melt 3 tbsp butter in a 12-inch skillet over medium. Add the onions and 1/4 tsp salt and cook, stirring every few minutes and lowering the heat as they darken, until deep amber and jammy, about 25 minutes.

steps.title: Heat the pot and make the salad
steps.body: While the onions cook, bring 16 cups (4 quarts) water and 2 tsp salt to a boil in the 8-quart pot. Toss the cucumber with the vinegar, sugar, dill, and 1/4 tsp salt and refrigerate. Runs inside step 2 (overlap stated).

steps.title: Make the spätzle
steps.body: Butter the baking dish with 1 tbsp butter. Working in 3 batches, press about a third of the batter through the spätzle maker (or a colander with large holes) into the 4 quarts of boiling water. When the spätzle float, cook 1 minute more, then lift them with a spider into the baking dish, layering each batch with a third of both cheeses and some pepper.

steps.title: Layer and bake
steps.body: Spread the onions over the top layer of cheese. Bake in the preheated 400 F oven until the cheese bubbles at the edges, 10 minutes.

steps.title: Serve
steps.body: Scatter chives over the spätzle and serve hot with the cucumber salad.

equipment: spätzle maker or colander with 1/4-inch holes
